info.title: MISO Public API - Operations Displays
info.description:
Real-time MISO system operations data behind the public Operations Displays on misoenergy.org: area control error, CSAT supply and demand, fuel mix, real-time total load, system snapshot, wind and solar generation, net actual and net scheduled interchange, regional directional transfer, and generation outages.

MISO notice, verbatim from https://www.misoenergy.org/markets-and-operations/RTDataAPIs/ : "For your convenience, MISO provides direct access to the source data behind the charts and tables displayed in real-time on this website. As of December 12, 2025, these data feeds are available in JSON format only. Please be aware that the underlying URLs have also changed for all links. This implementation is designed to improve consistency, performance, and future compatibility for accessing real-time data. Please be respectful of caching limits and avoid accessing these links more than once per minute to ensure system stability and fair usage for all users."

x-provenance.note: MISO publishes no OpenAPI for its Public API. This document was assembled from MISO's own published artifacts only: every path and every operation summary is taken verbatim from the endpoint table MISO publishes at https://public-api.misoenergy.org/ (section "Operations Displays"), and every response schema and example is derived from the live JSON MISO returned to an anonymous GET on 2026-07-27. No host, path, parameter, field name or value was invented. Examples are the real payloads with long arrays truncated to two elements. No query parameters are documented by MISO for these endpoints and none are asserted here.
sources: Every path in this document individually fetched anonymously; all returned HTTP 200 application/json on 2026-07-27.
